object.material_description: 25 mm conductive metal coin; alloy declared by test fixture

sensor_condition: healthy calibrated MIT/impedance/approved sensor array; object at a declared point in the coupling zone
failure_condition: Power transfer is admitted without detection/localization or an explicitly qualified safe mitigation envelope.
notes: Benchmark fixture inspired by the published 25 mm coin thermal study. This is a detection-policy scenario; no energized test is authorized by this record.

sensor_condition: healthy calibrated sensors; sheet located within the declared coupling/stray-field region
failure_condition: Object is missed, incorrectly localized, or transfer is enabled without a verified object-specific mitigation envelope.
notes: The active-DeMag study reports evaluating a 100 mm copper sheet; exact geometry and conditions must be extracted before claiming reproduction.

object.material_description: small ferrous fastener near a ferrite/shield edge

sensor_condition: healthy sensor array; object placed near the edge of a declared high-gradient region
failure_condition: Edge location causes a false negative or localization error large enough to invalidate thermal prediction.
notes: Tests spatial blind spots rather than only centered-object detection.

object.material_description: one conductive and one non-conductive object at separate declared positions

sensor_condition: healthy sensor array; simultaneous object signatures and possible overlapping fields
failure_condition: One object is suppressed by the other in inference, producing an unsafe aggregate 'clear' result.
notes: Multi-object tests are necessary because single-object classifier performance does not establish superposition or localization behaviour.

object.material_description: conductive alloy not represented in training or calibration set

sensor_condition: healthy sensors; material signature outside the frozen training/calibration distribution
failure_condition: Classifier emits a high-confidence CLEAR/NO-OBJECT decision on an out-of-distribution material.
notes: Abstention is a safe capability; a classifier must not force every input into a known class.

object.material_description: held-out conductive object from a new session

sensor_condition: bounded sensor offset/gain drift and environmental change between training and inference sessions
failure_condition: Raw-signal drift silently increases false negatives or detector confidence remains high when calibration is out of domain.
notes: Grounded by the MIT FOD paper's live cross-session drop: raw-value RF median+SGF reached 31/50 (62%) while engineered features reached 49/50 (98%).

object.material_description: declared conductive object during controlled WPT operation

sensor_condition: WPT carrier and harmonics produce EMI in the MIT/FOD sensor array; compare raw and drift/EMI-robust features
failure_condition: EMI masks an object or makes the detector report clear without a bounded uncertainty/abstention response.
notes: Published active-transfer MIT validation is small and controlled; this scenario demands power-, frequency- and alignment-stratified revalidation.

object.material_description: object state is treated as unknown because a sensor channel is unavailable

sensor_condition: one or more MIT channels are disconnected, stuck, saturated or return stale data
failure_condition: A partial/failed sensor array is silently treated as an object-free coupling zone.
notes: A detector's measured availability and fault coverage are part of safety; sensor failure must not look like a clean field.

object.material_description: conductive object near a localization cell boundary

sensor_condition: classifier detects an object but the localization confidence interval spans both safe and unsafe spatial cells
failure_condition: A point estimate is treated as exact and used to authorize a mitigation zone that may not cover the object.
notes: Use calibrated localization uncertainty and conservative spatial bounds rather than point accuracy only.

object.material_description: 25 mm coin with material, location, temperature response and orientation inside a separately verified DeMag envelope

sensor_condition: detection and localization pass; independent temperature sensing and DeMag branch health are valid
failure_condition: DeMag is enabled without localization, independent thermal validation, branch health, power budget or safe fallback; or temperature prediction exceeds its uncertainty-bounded limit.
notes: This scenario is only applicable after an independent safe test campaign establishes the DeMag envelope; the 2026 coin result is not blanket authorization for continued charging.

object.material_description: object is already detected and localized; mitigation actuator fault is injected synthetically

sensor_condition: DeMag auxiliary inverter, branch-current feedback or switch/coil health is reported failed or inconsistent
failure_condition: The controller continues transfer on the assumption that mitigation succeeded despite a failed or unverified DeMag actuator.
notes: A mitigation function is safety-critical and needs its own diagnostics, safe fallback and energy accounting.

object.material_description: object moves from its initially localized position during active transfer

sensor_condition: localization estimate changes outside the validated tracking envelope
failure_condition: The controller assumes the object remains within the original suppression region after movement.
notes: Object movement invalidates static localization and may move heating into an unmitigated hotspot.

object.material_description: object within a candidate mitigation envelope

sensor_condition: thermal sensor is delayed, biased, saturated or has failed plausibility checks
failure_condition: Temperature-based mitigation continues without trustworthy temperature feedback or a conservative validated thermal observer.
notes: A temperature-rise value from one coin experiment cannot replace independent thermal ground truth and sensor-lag analysis.

object.material_description: verified empty coupling region with reference thermal/field conditions

sensor_condition: healthy calibrated sensor array; independently verified empty region
failure_condition: Detector repeatedly false-triggers or activates mitigation under clean baseline conditions without explainable calibration/drift cause.
notes: Required to quantify false positives and avoid safety-driven but impractical nuisance shutdown.
